rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for expressing certainty or a definite prediction.

example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for a casual, emphatic “of course” or “surely,” especially in an affirmative reply.

example.english: Of course, I’ll certainly buy it for you.
example.jyutping: gang2 hai6 laa1 ngo5 bong1 nei5 maai5 maai4

rows.note: Use this for a neutral or polite affirmative “of course,” rather than the more emphatic 梗係.

example.english: Of course, you can certainly sit here.
example.jyutping: dong1 jin4 ho2 ji5 nei5 co5 ni1 bin1 laa1
